Messages.Author: Emiliano Imeroni
Messages.Body:
Hi,

I hope the following comment may be helpful to
the people taking care of the new player registry.

I checked my record and the record of few other
players I know, and...

...the registry seems unable to handle half victory
points!

For instance, if you look at my record (V:EKN ID 3295001),
I have 0 VP in Gen*Con continental qualifier, and 3 VP
in the day 2 of the Championship: these should be
respectively 0.5 and 3.5.

Notice that however the ratings are computed correctly,
taking into account the half VPs.

Let me use this occasion to point out another problem
in the registry, that was present also in the old version:
relative player rankings are not correctly computed
because of the bad handling of tied scores.

Let me explain it with an example (for a concrete one,
you may want to look at positions 42-46 of the current
world rankings). Suppose player A and B have 100
rating points each, while C has 50.

The rankings should then read:
1. player A, 100 pts
1. player B, 100 pts
*3*. player C, 50 pts

In the player registry, C would instead turn out to be
second, instead of third. And this error messes up
*all* the positions below.

Cheers,
Emiliano
